reviews_captured_by_me.text: Victor and his crew were amazing to work with. They were polite, professional, and made the entire process smooth—from scheduling the estimate to delivery and installation. The quality of work was excellent, and the pricing was very fair. I would highly recommend VL Granite to anyone looking for high-quality craftsmanship and great value.

Victor and his team were amazing to work with. They were very professional and knowledgeable. You could tell that they wanted to provide quality work. When installing they were very cognizant of our kitchen remodel and not damaging cabinets. They left after installation with everything cleaned up. They were very kind and courteous while here. The whole team was able to provide information that we needed to know about our new countertops. They are amazing and beautiful! I will definitely use them again in the future.

We're without words.... We’re absolutely thrilled with every aspect of our project with VL Granite & Marble LLC!!
From the initial countertop selection stage, (working with Izzet who supplied premium Crystallo quartzite slabs), through final installation, Victor was extremely responsive, professional, creative & a joy to work with!!
We initially contracted VL Granite & Marble (based on great reviews), for our kitchen countertop fabrication & installation.  But Victor was so amazing, we requested he extend the scope to our bathrooms.  Victor (both Jr. & Sr.), worked tirelessly on our requests (from finding the perfect materials to working after hours/weekends to accommodate our schedule).
The VL Granite & Marble installation team was conscientious, professional & detail oriented.  In addition, they proactively suggested a creative way to use a cut out remnant to extend our backsplash while on site.   If this wasn't enough, when post fabrication it was clear my husband had ordered the wrong size sink, Victor & team went way above & beyond.  They offered to return the next night (after working all day on their scheduled job, driving an extra hour + up the mountain on a Friday night), to install our kitchen island after the cabinet company made the necessary adjustments.
All in all, we couldn't be happier with their brilliant team, the overall project experience, their craftsmanship & the awesome results of our new kitchen countertops!!
